whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Swaad-e-Patna,

I noticed your cafe has a wonderful presence near Prema Ford Showroom on Bypass Road in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for online table reservations and home delivery orders.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp menu ordering, table booking, aur specials showcase integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/swaad

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Swaad-e-Patna team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp menu ordering and table booking features for your location near Prema Ford Showroom on Bypass Road. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes aur actual photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain."
